description: Gateway event ingest of the WojtusDiscord bot: volume and handler time per event type, failures, database write gaps, gateway connection, backfill and health checks. Job wojtusdiscord.
title: WojtusDiscord / Events & Ingest

options.content: **What does the bot ingest, how fast, and what fails?** Pick event types at the top left; totals cover the time range.

panels.title: Events

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Gateway events in the range, selected event types. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Failed events

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Events with at least one failed handler in the range.

panels.title: Serialization failures

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Events stored with a fallback payload because the serializer failed. The handlers still ran.

panels.title: Dead letters

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Failures the database refused, written to the JSONL fallback file in the range.

panels.title: Handler p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__range])))

panels.description: 95th percentile of the time an event spends in the pipeline, over the range.

panels.title: Failed share

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Failed events as a share of all events in the range.

panels.title: Events per minute by type

targets.expr: sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Gateway events by event type, all outcomes. The legend sorts by total. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Events per minute by outcome

targets.expr: sum by (outcome)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: One outcome per event: ok, failed (a handler threw) or serialization_failed.

panels.title: Events by type

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m])))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Events per event type in the range.

panels.title: Share of events by type

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / scalar(sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Each selected event type as a share of the selected events in the range.

panels.title: Raw payload size p95 by type

targets.expr: sort_desc(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, event_type)(rate(wojtus_event_raw_size_bytes_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__range]))) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 95th percentile of the JSON size stored in raw_event_logs, over the range. Buckets end at 1 MiB.

panels.title: Handler duration percentiles

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__rate_interval])))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Time one gateway event spends in the event pipeline, selected event types.

panels.title: Handler duration heatmap
panels.description: Events per duration bucket and interval. Bucket bounds: 5 ms to 30 s.

targets.expr: sum by (le)(increase(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__interval]))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.title: Handler p95 by type

targets.expr: sort_desc(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, event_type)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__range]))) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 95th percentile handler time per event type over the range.

panels.title: Handler p95 by type over time

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, event_type)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__rate_interval])))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 95th percentile handler time per event type. No point when no event arrives.

panels.title: Raw payload bytes per second

targets.expr: sum by (event_type)(rate(wojtus_event_raw_size_bytes_sum{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Bytes of raw event JSON written to raw_event_logs, by event type.

panels.title: Handler failures by event type

targets.expr: sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Failures handed to FailedEventService per interval, hard and soft. One event can record more than one failure. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Handler failures by handler

targets.expr: sum by (handler)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_event_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: The same failures by handler name.

panels.title: Dead letters

targets.expr: sum by (event_type, handler)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Failures the database refused, sent to the JSONL fallback. Each one needs a manual replay.

panels.title: Serialization failures by type

targets.expr: sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Events whose payload the serializer could not write. Read the 2026-05 blackout notes before a change to RawEventLogService.

panels.title: Unwritable window pending

targets.expr: max(wojtus_db_unwritable_window_pending{job="wojtusdiscord"})

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 1 while an unwritable-database window is open or waits for its row.

panels.title: Heartbeat writes by outcome

targets.expr: sum by (outcome)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_heartbeat_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_heartbeat_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_heartbeat_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_heartbeat_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_db_unwritable_failed_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_db_unwritable_failed_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_db_unwritable_failed_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_db_unwritable_failed_writes_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Heartbeat rows per minute; the bot writes one every 5 s, so ok is 12 per minute. A failed write that counts toward an unwritable window is a separate series.

panels.title: Gateway latency

targets.expr: max(wojtus_gateway_latency_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"})

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Gateway heartbeat latency as DSharpPlus reports it.

panels.title: Gateway connected

targets.expr: min(wojtus_gateway_connected{job="wojtusdiscord"})

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 1 when every gateway shard is connected. A gap is a bot restart.

panels.title: Socket closes by close code

targets.expr: sum by (close_code)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_gateway_socket_closed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_gateway_socket_closed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_gateway_socket_closed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_gateway_socket_closed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Gateway socket closes per interval. 1000 and 1001 are normal closes; 4xxx codes are Discord errors. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Session resumes and guild downloads

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_gateway_session_resumed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_gateway_session_resumed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_gateway_session_resumed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_gateway_session_resumed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_gateway_guild_download_completed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_gateway_guild_download_completed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_gateway_guild_download_completed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_gateway_guild_download_completed_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Warm reconnects and cold connects per interval. A cold connect follows every bot start.

panels.title: Time since last event by kind

targets.expr: time() - max by (kind)(wojtus_last_event_by_kind_timestamp_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 0)

defaults.noValue: No event since the bot started

panels.description: Time since the last gateway event of each kind. A sawtooth: it grows until the next event. Long teeth at night are normal.

panels.title: Members in voice channels

targets.expr: max(wojtus_voice_members{job="wojtusdiscord"})

panels.description: Members connected to a voice channel now, as the bot's cache sees them.

panels.title: Health checks

targets.expr: max by (check)(wojtus_healthcheck_failing{job="wojtusdiscord"})

panels.description: One band per check of the bot's HealthCheckJob: green while it passes, red while it fails.

panels.title: Health-check ages

targets.expr: max by (check)(wojtus_healthcheck_value{job="wojtusdiscord",check=~"ingest_stall|open_downtime"})
max by (event_type)(wojtus_healthcheck_value{job="wojtusdiscord",check="event_silence"})

panels.description: The checks that measure a time: age of the newest raw event (ingest_stall), age of an open downtime row (open_downtime) and the silence per watched event type (event_silence).

panels.title: Health-check counts

targets.expr: max by (check)(wojtus_healthcheck_value{job="wojtusdiscord",check!~"ingest_stall|open_downtime|event_silence"})

panels.description: The checks that count: failed events, restarts in 30 minutes (crash_loop), event types below their baseline (event_ratio), stalled backfills, rows that break the timestamp invariant.

panels.title: Health-check alerts by check

targets.expr: sum by (check)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_healthcheck_alerts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_healthcheck_alerts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_healthcheck_alerts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_healthcheck_alerts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Alerts the bot's HealthCheckJob sent to Discord, per interval. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Webhook failures

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_healthcheck_webhook_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_healthcheck_webhook_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_healthcheck_webhook_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_healthcheck_webhook_failures_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m]))

panels.description: Health-check alerts the webhook did not deliver. Such an alert reached nobody.

panels.description: Downtime rows the bot wrote, per interval, by type.

panels.title: Upserts per minute by entity

targets.expr: sum by (entity)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.description: Entity upserts (guild, channel, user, member, ...) per minute. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Upserts per minute by result

targets.expr: sum by (result)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_upserts_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.description: The same upserts by result. 'conflict' means another writer won the race and the row was read back.

panels.title: Boot phases, last start

targets.expr: max by (phase)(wojtus_boot_phase_duration_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"})

panels.description: Duration of each phase of the last start: migrate, backfill_sweep, guild_download, quick_sync.

panels.title: Boot phases across restarts

targets.expr: max by (phase)(wojtus_boot_phase_duration_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"})

panels.description: The same durations over time. Each step is one bot start; the value holds until the next.
